# spectup

> > spectup is a Berlin-based startup advisory and fundraising agency that has helped portfolio companies raise over $120M through pitch deck design, financial modeling, investor outreach, and strategic consulting.

spectup specializes in early-stage and growth-stage startup fundraising across Europe and the United States. The agency combines design expertise, financial strategy, and direct investor access to accelerate capital raises for companies across AI, climate tech, fintech, and other sectors.

## Key Topics

- Capital Raising
- Investor Outreach
- Pitch Deck Design
- Financial Modeling
- Investor Matchmaking
- Fundraising Strategy
- Investor Relations
- Startup Consulting
- Investor Targeting
- Private Placement
- AI & Robotics
- Climate Tech
- FinTech
- B2B Lead Generation
- VC Networks

## Core Services

- [Startup Fundraising Consultant: $120M+ Raised](https://www.spectup.com/fundraising-consultant): Expert fundraising consultant service with VC access and dealflow systems
- [Top Pitch Deck Agency: Custom Design & Strategy](https://www.spectup.com/pitch-deck-services): spectup's pitch deck design and strategy service for fundraising
- [Investor Outreach Service: $120M Raised. Yours Next](https://www.spectup.com/investor-outreach-service): Investor outreach and matchmaking service connecting startups globally
- [Financial Modeling Service for Fundraising](https://www.spectup.com/financial-modeling-consultant): Financial modeling and projections service for startup fundraising
- [Private Placement Agent for Funds & Private Companies](https://www.spectup.com/private-placement-agent): Private placement agent connecting funds with LPs and family offices
- [Lead Gen Agency for Fast Growth | B2B Lead Experts](https://www.spectup.com/lead-gen-agency): B2B lead generation agency with multi-channel outreach systems
